articleTitle: Peculiarities of Vibration Signal Processing Techniques Application to Inertial Way Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Analysis of vibration signals that are excited when a train moves over rail irregularities requires special processing in the time, frequency, and time-frequency domains. This is important for detecting those rail irregularities and obtaining their parameters, and also for accurate isolation of low-frequency components of the studied signal. These low-frequency components have different origin. Application of the continuous wavelet transform based on the fast Fourier transform allows us to separate low-frequency components from high-frequency ones, which makes it possible to reconstruct the vertical movement of the car's wheel. Discrete-time wavelet transform is efficient for signal reconstruction and denoising. On the other hand, spectrogram based on the Fourier transform helps to locate harmonic components and obtain the time-frequency representation of the original signal. In the present paper we study techniques of vibration signal processing and make conclusions regarding their application.

articleTitle: Development of an Intelligent Robotic System for Recognizing and Transporting Postal Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Now computer science methods are actively used in different areas of Industry 4.0., including in the postal service to automate the transportation of postal items. The problem of transportation is particularly acute for postal objects of large volumes and weights, as it is performed manually and is one of the most time-consuming operations. The article describes the development of a prototype intelligent robotic system with computer vision to recognize and transport such postal objects (parcels). An analysis of modern scientific and practical developments, methods and means of image processing, including methods of contour analysis, and video stream processing algorithms is carried out. The stages of design and integration of the computer vision subsystem into the robotic complex are described.

articleTitle: Development of Labor Safety Information Systems for Railway Transport
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of information technologies to support the labor protection system in the field of railway transport using risk management and quality management tools. On the basis of statistical data, an analysis of hazardous events and risks for the personnel of JSC «Russian Railways» was carried out. The standards of the labor protection management system in JSC «Russian Railways» are considered. The existing application of information technologies for the organization of labor protection in the company is considered. Recommendations for the development of information technologies to support the management of labor protection in the company using risk management and quality management tools are proposed. The advantages of developing an integrated management system as part of the quality management system, risk management system and labor protection management system are substantiated. Directions for the development of information systems in the field of labor protection for JSC «Russian Railways» are proposed.

articleTitle: Application of Empirical Mode Decomposition to Reduce Signal Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Signals can be affected by noise, which is a type of unwanted signal. Noise can make it difficult to extract useful information from a signal and can result in incorrect output. Filtering out noise before using it to analyze a signal is a common pre-processing step. In this paper, a new method is proposed to reduce signal noise based on empirical decomposition method (EMD). EMD decomposes the signal into a set of oscillating modes called intrinsic mode functions (IMFs), and noise reduction involves reconstructing this signal using IMFs by adding them together according to a mathematical formula to finally arrive at a signal with very low noise. Then the result is verified using a standard based on determining the error value (SNR) between the original signal and the filtered signals, after which a spectral analysis of the resulting signals is performed and compared with the spectrum of the original signal. The method was tested on simulated data of a signal (Bumps), where the results show that EMD technology may prove to be an effective technique for reducing signal noise. The motivation for this research work was derived from the quest to develop EMD-based filters for signal filtering and feature extraction with better results as compared to other filters.

articleTitle: Automatic Traffic Control of Autonomous Vessels in Coastal Waters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper examines an approach to arrange marine autonomous surface ships (both with and without crew) traffic surveillance illustrated with the Amur Bay and the Golden Horn Bay water area of the city of Vladivostok. The approach involves real-time application of a computer alliance based on General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) and Global Positioning System (GPS) satellite navigation technologies. The research presents the diagram of the system to observe autonomous surface ships located in the coastal area, as well as the assessment algorithm of the current navigation. Machine learning methods applied for analyzing the obtained information contribute to the fast and quite accurate review of the surface navigation, as well as hazard evaluation of vehicles caught in the area of heading in a sea autonomous surface vessel assessment.

articleTitle: Improving the Reliability of Railway Automatic Couplers Under Track Geometry Deviations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The increasing need to ensure safe rolling stock operation warrants an analysis of the criteria leading to failures and breakdowns during both use and downtime. Ensuring trouble-free coupling of rail cars is one of the railroad priorities. This applies to both coupling of new cars and prevention of spontaneous uncoupling of rolling stock cars. Due to the non-ideal nature of tracks, namely, availability of curved sections in both horizontal and vertical projections, the axes of the automatic couplers are likely to diverge. Despite the developed railroad maintenance regulations, the reach of the car dimensions is not always correctly assessed, resulting in irreparable consequences. This paper proposes a method for improving the reliability of automatic coupling devices due to the implementation of various guide centering systems.

articleTitle: Fiber-Optical Measuring Networks for Hydro-Engineering Facilities Security Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper deals with a fiber-optical tomographic problem showed for monitoring marine hydro-engineering constructions controlled by fiber-optical measuring networks comprising fiber-optical lines/links. The study presents the description of a packing diagram of fiber-optical measuring lines in three directions. The paper also illustrates the results of a mathematical calculation of recovery (backing up) of binary action performed by algebraic methods. Using such fiber-optical measuring lines is possible on surfaces with a complicated, arbitrary profile, whereas fiber-optical element/component base (software) allows using them for security monitoring of especially dangerous Class I and II hydro-engineering constructions.

articleTitle: Cross-Coupling Analysis of Accelerations of the Axle Boxes of the Car Bogie
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Inertial method of railway track diagnostics involves detection and measurement of the defects' parameters based on the readings of accelerometers installed on the axle boxes of the car bogie. During the train's movement the car body and the track constitute a single oscillatory system; thus, an accelerometer corresponding to a certain wheel of the bogie measures both the accelerations caused by immediate impact suffered by that wheel, and the echoes from the impacts on other elements of the system. This contributes to the error in measuring the parameters of defects and can lead to false positive errors during their detection. Present paper considers an approach to determining the energy redistribution within the system, as well as taking this redistribution into account during defect detection.

articleTitle: Intelligent Building Emergencies Control System Requirements
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The work is devoted to identifying the requirements for an intelligent building emergency control system. To prevent emergencies, the system must perform certain functions aimed at preventing the consequences of identifiable accidents. The paper presents an analysis of existing Smart Home systems. Functional and non-functional requirements for the system are developed. Built a diagram of the precedents for the intelligent control system of emergencies in the building, which will further be used in the implementation of the system. And also justified the need to implement the system because of improving the quality and timeliness of response to emergencies.

articleTitle: Development of Hardware and Software to Ensure Process Safety and Reliability in Railway Transport
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of building a unified information system for ensuring the reliability and safety of transport systems based on system analysis, risk management, process approach and reliability theory. General mathematical approaches to the creation of a model describing processes in transport systems are considered. An algorithm and tools for analyzing the risks of hazardous situations are proposed. The problem of increasing reliability and security based on the means of control and information support within the framework of the model is analyzed. An example of modeling dangerous processes in the operation of a railway station is considered. Software and hardware are proposed that increase the reliability and safety of work at the railway station.

articleTitle: Prospects for Including a DATA Decision Support System in a Civil Servant's Automated Workplace
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: As public administration increasingly relies on decision support systems, the Russian Federation can benefit from implementing a standard automated workplace for civil servants. With access to the latest digital technologies, regular employees of regional governments can make informed decisions even amidst external uncertainties affecting the socio-economic system. This article focuses on the potential of the “DATA” decision support system in regional management. It investigates how typical automated workplace tools can be utilized to evaluate the impact of environmental factors on the regional socio-economic system within the context of the Federal Project “Digital Economy”. The architecture of the “DATA” system is also discussed, highlighting its separate modules and secure data access. Overall, automating decision support can improve management activities, and standardizing the automated workplace can lead to significant benefits for public administration in the Russian Federation.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Text Messages Classifier for Chatbots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Authors developed and tested various models, which can classificate impersonal messages from dialogues between citizens and support service specialists of a housing management company. To solve the problems connected with the imbalance in the input dataset, we proposed a two-stage classification model. On the first stage, a rule-based model is applied. Second stage contains machine learning and deep learning models, which use various text vectorization methods.

articleTitle: Development of Online Services System for Banking Organizations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of improving the quality and ensuring information security of online banking services. The structure of indicators of the quality of online banking services is proposed, information threats are analyzed. The issues of information security for the online banking services system are considered. Recommendations are given for the development of banking IT services targeted on improving the quality and security of online customer service system performance.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Computational Complexity of Fast Matrix Multiplication Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Matrix multiplication is a commonly used operation in various graphics, imaging, robotics, and signal processing applications. In connection with the increase in the growth of the characteristics of digital information, it is necessary to improve the algorithms for processing information and the efficiency of their implementation. Various fast matrix multiplication algorithms are used to solve this problem. This paper presents a comparative analysis of the computational complexity of matrix multiplication implemented using the direct, Strassen and Coopersmith-Winograd algorithms. A theoretical analysis showed that the use of fast matrix multiplication algorithms can reduce the delay and area compared to the direct algorithm to 82.68% and 5.03%, respectively, depending on the selected adder, matrix multiplication algorithm and matrix size. In further research, it is planned to implement matrix multiplication hardware using the Strassen and Coopersmith-Winograd algorithms on FPGA and ASIC, and their comparative analysis.

articleTitle: Using Neural Networks for EFL Learning and Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the impact of the use of neural networks and tools available in Russia through the Internet on the organization of teaching and learning foreign languages at Russian universities and colleges. Based on the study of the involvement of the teachers of the chair of foreign language at Russian University of Transport in the use of neural networks to teach English as a foreign language, the most promising areas of the use of artificial intelligence are identified, the issues of open interaction between teachers and students using neural networks are analyzed, possible changes in the organization of teaching and learning a foreign language are determined. The results obtained were compared with the corresponding responses of English as a foreign language teachers working at colleges in Russia. Some recommendations for improving the system of exercises for studying a particular topic of the Working Program of the discipline “Foreign Language” are presented.

articleTitle: Classification of IT Tools Based on Bloom's Taxonomy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The task of improving the quality of engineering education to increase the country's competitiveness is one of the urgent needs. One of the problems is the low methodical literacy of content teachers, the core of which is the ability to use the potential of IT tools and relate their implementation with natural cognitive processes of mastering knowledge and skills. The solution to the problem is to classify IT tools in relation to Bloom's taxonomy, which reflects the natural process of learning. The authors offer a sequence of subprocesses of pedagogical support for the stages of mastering knowledge and skills according to Bloom's taxonomy. A taxonomy-based classification of IT learning tools verified by expert evaluation is developed. The results contribute to the efficiency of IT tools' usage based on Bloom's taxonomy. The results can be used in the development of the advanced training programs for content teachers.

articleTitle: The Prediction of Contact Radio Interference in the Tasks of Ensuring Electromagnetic Compatibility of Radioelectronic Means on Mobile Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses the forecasting of contact radio interference, which is an essential aspect in maintaining the necessary electromagnetic compatibility level of electronic devices installed in mobile objects. The presented algorithm for predicting contact radio interference makes it possible to expand the possibilities in the design of radio communication systems in the presence of a variety of electronic devices on mobile objects. After analyzing the methods of predicting contact radio interference, recommendations were developed to reduce the impact of this type of interference. Contact radio interference is a type of interference that occurs due to the reemission of a secondary electromagnetic field from mobile conductive structures containing detachable circuit connections. The use of uneven spectral density of contact noise makes it possible to correctly distribute the frequencies of radio equipment, placing the receiving frequencies in areas with low spectral density of contact noise.

articleTitle: The Neural Networks Application in Information Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The subject of the article is the neural networks application in the cryptography methods of the information security. The objects of the investigations are the information systems in quality management. The goal is to reduce the cost of the neural network design and training. The cryptography methods with the closed key were used. The neural networks with the flexible and adaptive switcher structure were developed. The switcher neuron networks were designed of the subnetworks and the switch communication structure. The training and the design of the switcher neural networks were performed on the base of the layer by layer training and synthesis. The training set is the secret key in the cryptography method with the closed key.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Differential Robot Drive in Gazebo
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A differential drive is one of the most common drives in robotics that drives a robot by rotating two wheels at different speeds. This article discusses the features of modeling a robot differential drive in the Gazebo simulator. In particular, the key challenges that designers face when modeling differential drive, such as motion control and wheel inertia modeling, will be presented, as well as solutions that can be applied to achieve the desired results. The article will also describe how to use ROS (Robot Operating System) to simulate differential drive in Gazebo. ROS provides tools for controlling a robot in a simulation and provides a convenient way to exchange data between the components of a robot system. Finally, several examples will be presented showing how Gazebo can be used to simulate various types of differential drive robots, including wheeled robots and mobile robots with wide tracks. These examples demonstrate how proper simulation of a differential drive can be useful for developing and testing robot control algorithms in simulation, which can greatly speed up the development process and reduce the cost of experimental work.

articleTitle: Real-Time System for Detection Hidden and Visible Keypoints of Rainbow Trout
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this paper, we describe the experience of applying deep learning methods to the detection of eight keypoints of rainbow trout. Using the two loss functions combination and hyperparameters tuning, our solution achieves performance comparable with state-of-the-art results of human keypoints detection. The obtained result enables the digital transformation of aquaculture industries and the automation of production processes, through the implementation of a wide range of video analysis algorithms providing such capabilities as non-contact fish counting, weighing, behavior analysis, and diagnosis of diseases.

articleTitle: Chatbot Technology as an Artificial Intelligence Tool in Foreign Language Education
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the introduction of artificial intelligence tools into educational practice. Chatbot is considered as one of these platforms. The authors treat a concept of an educational chatbot in foreign language teaching. It is given a description of the technical characteristics of an educational chatbot creation and development. Their varieties, advantages and disadvantages are also analyzed. It is claimed that chatbots can realize both administrative and educational functions in educational process. Based on the analysis of existing platforms, they are described the stages of students' work on the development of foreign language speech skills during the interaction with chatbots. Methodological recommendations for the structure of a chatbot as an educational platform are proposed. It is concluded that the use of educational chatbots will allow students to work out the learned patterns and speech models, will help to form the skills of correspondence in social networks and messengers. All these factors will contribute to overcoming the psychological barrier which students experience at the beginning of the real foreign language communication.

articleTitle: Implementation of Digital Technologies in Production Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modern production requires modern methods of management and organization of processes. The most important methods are digitalization of big data collection, storage and analysis, control of production and management processes, building a product lifecycle management system based on modern information technologies. The article shows the role of information technology in a successful enterprise. Analytics helps to understand the information contained in big data. Visualization of data provides for more efficient use by humans. Blockchain is another digital technology with future potential for quality improvement, especially in the field of security and traceability. The connection between information technologies (IT) and operational technologies (OT) is shown, where IT includes the enterprise quality management system (EQMS), enterprise resource planning (ERP) and product lifecycle management (PLM), and OT are technologies used in production.

articleTitle: University Teaching Load Distribution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article presents an overview of the main algorithms used in resource distribution problems. The description, input and output data, as well as peculiarities and complexity of these algorithms are considered. The paper proposes a modified algorithm for finding vapor combinations in a graph, which allows solving the problem of optimal load distribution between the teachers of a structural subdivision of the university and the disciplines that this subdivision is obliged to implement in an academic year. The need for modification of the algorithm is argued by the unevenness and variability of the subject area, multi-criteria load assignment and the need to take into account subjective characteristics of the decision on allocation.

articleTitle: Coding Standards and Quality Checks: Key Factors for Successful Software Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article highlights the challenge developers face in modern software development, where time constraints affect their ability to focus on code quality. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining high-quality code to prevent defects and ensure project success. The article suggests possible solutions, such as automation tools, coding standards, and best practices, to improve code quality and streamline development. It also discusses the significance of two aspects of code quality: functional and structural, and how to improve both through coding standards and automatic code analysis.

articleTitle: Application of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms and Game Theory to Optimize the Offloading of a Mobile Edge Computing System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: At the moment, Internet of Things technologies are widely used in industry, in the design of smart cities and digital twins. Due to the limited amount of computing resources on local mobile devices, cloud and edge computing technologies are widely used. This article provides an overview of algorithms based on game theory and reinforcement learning needed to solve the problem of offloading the system.

articleTitle: Simulation of Three-Phase Circuits with Nonlinear Load
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: When studying the features of electrical circuits with nonlinear elements in the course “Theoretical Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering”, students face with the problem of analytical analysis complexity. The use of software allows to optimize the learning process and consider more different options for tasks. Dynamic processes in three-phase alternating current circuits with a nonlinear load in the form of a coil with a ferromagnetic core and distinctive features of the analysis of such circuits are described. In connection with the difficulties of analytical calculations, the use of numerical analysis methods by means of the MatLab software is proposed.

articleTitle: About the Choice of Data Balance Method for Neural Network Classification of Electrocardiogram Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Diseases of the cardiovascular system are the main cause of death in the world population. Classification of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals is a reliable method for diagnosing cardiac pathologies. The available ECG databases consist of an unequal number of signals from various pathologies. This article analyzes the impact of using class alignment methods on the result of neural network classification of ECG signals. The results demonstrate that the SMOTE GRU algorithm provides high performance in classifying ECG segments, while the BiLSTM ROS algorithm provides high performance in classifying full ECG signals. The Accuracy, Loss, Recall, Precision, F-score values are respectively 70.31% and 77.73%, 0.29 and 0.41, 90.1% and 96.0%, 78.8% and 83.4%, 88.5% and 95.3%.

articleTitle: Expressive Audio Data Augmentation Based on Speech Synthesis and Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper is dedicated to exploring the possibilities of using speech synthesis technologies and deep neural networks to expand small datasets of expressive acoustic data by generating new samples. Currently, there are almost no Russian-language emotional speech datasets publicly available with enough data to train a competitive language model. The article explores architectures of neural networks capable of transforming textual and acoustic sequences into new acoustic data with the control of their emotional coloring. The generative modeling approaches applied to TTS systems that improve the expressive ability of deep architectures are considered.

articleTitle: Automation of the Selection of Components Placement Surfaces Using 3D Drawings
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses possible variants of the algorithm for automated surfaces selection for the subsequent basing of the parts, based on the use of a graph of dimensional relationships, discusses the principles of model construction in modern CAD programs, and also in programs for creating computer graphics based on polygonal modeling.

articleTitle: Information Technologies in the Organization of Production and Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Digital transformation affects an increasing number of areas of activity of each enterprise or organization. In this paper, the most common information technologies implemented in the organization of production and quality management are considered.

articleTitle: Firmware Intellectual System Application in Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The object of the article is the quality management system. The goal of investigation is to improve hardware and software tools, expand functions by the artificial intellect methods. The structures of software and hardware tools were developed. The system consists of elements that are designed as unified firmware modules. Three types of modules were used -algorithmic, intellectual and communication modules. Algorithmic modules execute codes of the program stored in memory. Intellectual modules contain fragments of previously trained artificial neural network. The communication modules provide the interaction and interconnection of elements and the exchange of information in the system.

articleTitle: Description of the Multistable States of an Optical Computer Using Nonlinear Fokker-Planck Equations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the problems that could arise in complex optical computing systems based on the principles of multi or bi stability. In general, the state of multistable systems can be investigated using nonlinear Fokker-Planck equations. On the basis of the above equations, possible transitions between multistable states that occur under external influences are considered.

articleTitle: Development of the Model for Automating the Process of Information Transfer in Order to Increase Its Reliability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Operation the relevant and reliable information is a strategically important aspect of modern society. Unfortunately, the manipulation of false data and its deliberate dissemination are increasingly being used by attackers. The article is devoted to the development of methods for automated modeling of the information spreading processes among employees of a large industrial enterprise in order to timely prevent the formation of wrong opinions. The results of the study could be used both in assessing the opinions of employees of large organizations and public opinion in general.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Electronic Document Management System Availability based on In-House IT-Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The object of the study is an Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) availability designed to operate within a corporate information system for processing information classified as Personal Data or a Trade Secret pursuant to the established procedure and in accordance with the applicable legislation. EDMS solutions based on international IT-components have been used for a long time, while availability issues were resolved at the level of database management systems, operating systems, etc. The identified contradictions (between the price of EDMS and imposed security countermeasures; the level of availability, convenience to the end user, etc.) require the new solutions effective implementation. Therefore many projects remain under full control of the in-house IT infrastructure, which is created, updated and managed only internally, without the external consultant's involvement. It provides an additional degree of sensitive information security and allows establishing their own “competence center” for up to date digital transformation technologies.

articleTitle: The Impact of the Development of Mobile Communication Technologies on the Transformation of a Digital Product
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article reveals the impact of the development of mobile communication technologies on the transformation of a digital product. Based on the disclosure of consistently changing technologies and mobile communication standards, the technological reasons for the evolution of the value of digital products are substantiated. Based on the changes in the key services of mobile communication networks of the fifth and sixth generations, the principles of expanding product and functional capabilities of production, new concepts of the essence of digital services and products are formulated. The substantiation of the system transformation of the production of products in physical and virtual environments in accordance with the needs of people and devices allowed us to reveal the essence and forms of multi-spatial future products produced and implemented in the meta-space at the merger of the physical and virtual worlds.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Information Technology Equivalence in Telemedicine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: - An equivalent transition between information technologies should be carried out while maintaining the level of general information security. The main goal of the study is defined - it concerns the development of an analytical model for controlling the equivalence of information technologies in information security systems. The current state in the field of information security is analyzed. It was revealed that the tools and mechanism existing today and presented on the relevant market that prevent risks and threats to the functioning of information systems associated with theft and distortion of data are “narrow”, that is, adapted to solving local problems facing attackers.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Teaching English Language to Engineering Bachelors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Neural networks function and interact in different areas. Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies are applied in teaching foreign languages in the modern educational system. The purpose of the study was to identify the possibilities of using available artificial intelligence services in teaching the English language in the academic environment. The study used theoretical analysis of pedagogical literature and the questionnaire-diagnostic method. The System Usability Scale (SUS) and Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) were chosen as diagnostic tools for analyzing the characteristics of AI services (Scribble Diffusion, Metavoice, Pictory, ChatGPT). The study involved 96 undergraduate engineering bachelors from South Ural State University. The degree of students' satisfaction with the implementation of AI services was analyzed through the questionnaire. The presented results of the ascertaining experiment confirmed the feasibility and the effectiveness of integrating AI services in teaching the English language to engineering bachelors in the educational process.
